Justice Surya Kant to take oath as India’s 53rd Chief Justice today; Know his inspiring journey | Dynamite News
item.description: Justice Surya Kant, born in a modest farming family in Haryana’s Hisar district, will take oath as the 53rd Chief Justice of India today on Monday. Rising from a government school student to the country’s top judicial post, his remarkable journey reflects determination, brilliance and integrity.

item.title: CJI Oath Ceremony Live: Justice Surya Kant Becomes India’s 53rd Chief Justice; Key Highlights from Oath Ceremony | Dynamite News
item.description: Justice Surya Kant, set to be sworn in today as the 53rd Chief Justice of India, embodies a remarkable journey from a small village in Haryana to the nation’s highest judicial office. Born into a humble family, he rose through perseverance, academic excellence and dedication to the law.

item.title: Delhi air pollution hits hazardous levels, AQI crosses 400; NCR breathing toxic air | Dynamite News
item.description: Delhi’s air quality has deteriorated to alarming levels, with AQI crossing 400 in several areas, including Ghazipur. The toxic air has created a thick smog, affecting visibility and health across the capital and NCR. PM2.5 and PM10 remain the major pollutants.

item.title: Justice Surya Kant takes oath as the 53rd Chief Justice of India | Dynamite News
item.description: Justice Surya Kant sworn in today as the 53rd Chief Justice of India at Rashtrapati Bhawan, where the President administered the oath. Rising from a modest village in Haryana to the nation’s highest judicial office, his journey reflects determination and exceptional legal acumen.

item.title: Gold, Silver prices drop sharply today; Buyers get a golden opportunity | Dynamite News
item.description: Gold and silver prices witnessed a sharp decline on November 24, giving buyers an attractive opportunity during the wedding season. According to the Indian Bullion and Jewellers Association (IBJA), 24-carat gold fell to ₹1,23,146 per 10 grams, while silver dropped to ₹1,51,129 per kilogram.

item.title: Pakistan: Blast at Peshawar Federal Police headquarters kills 3, injures 2 | Dynamite News
item.description: A suicide attack rocked the Federal Police Headquarters in Peshawar, Pakistan, on Monday, killing three officers and injuring two others. Security forces neutralized the attackers before they could cause further damage. The incident occurred in a crowded area near military cantonments, prompting an emergency response at Lady Reading Hospital.

item.title: Delhi protest at India Gate turns violent; Slogans for Naxal Hidma, several detained | Dynamite News
item.description: A protest against worsening air quality at India Gate in Delhi turned chaotic when demonstrators shouted slogans in support of slain Naxal commander Hidma. Several police personnel were injured after protesters allegedly used pepper spray. Authorities detained 15 protesters, and security at India Gate has been tightened.

item.title: INS Mahe Joins Indian Navy, Strengthens Anti-Submarine Warfare; Details here | Dynamite News
item.description: India’s naval strength received a major boost with the induction of INS Mahe, a state-of-the-art anti-submarine warfare (ASW) ship. Built with over 80% indigenous equipment under Atmanirbhar Bharat, INS Mahe can detect and neutralize underwater threats in shallow and deep waters.
